---
title: "M5-01 Reproducibility Inventory"
format: gfm
---

Status: current

## Question

Which numeric statements in the existing M0–M4 performance reports and contract evidence have a reproducible source, and which evidence gaps remain?

## Method

The committed extractor [claims.py](../../analysis/simciv_analysis/claims.py) reads the report/contract source tree. Its tidy output [claims.csv.gz](claims.csv.gz) contains **32,465** rows; the prior packed ledger [superseded/claims.csv](superseded/claims.csv) contains **37,612** expanded scalar values. Excluded inputs are table columns or labeled assignments for population/workload sizes, group and neighbor counts, seeds, replicates, horizons/days, thread/chunk settings, and simulation parameter values. Free-text numbers are only extracted from tables, report Summary/Findings/Status sections, selected audit/graduation tables, and measured contract sections. The machine-readable contracts/m1_contract.toml is a configuration/contract input and is not scanned as a measured report.

## Results

Every table below is generated from [claims.csv.gz](claims.csv.gz) by the report generator [report_m5_01.py](../../analysis/simciv_analysis/report_m5_01.py). Old-ledger comparisons additionally read the retained packed ledger.

The tidy ledger contains **783** headline claims, **895** key claims, and **30,787** supporting claims.

| --------- | --------------- |
| M2        | 288             |
| M3        | 412             |

Headline rows come from report Summary, Findings, and Status sections plus audit/graduation tables; full gate tables are excluded. Other gate verdicts remain in the `key` tier.

### Old and tidy ledger comparison

| Ledger view        | rows   | mapped before (exact name/line/value) | mapped after (renamed report/source/value) | unmapped after | reason                                                                             | mapped from old metadata |
| ------------------ | ------ | ------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------ | -------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------ |
| old packed records | 37,612 | 653                                   | 1,988                                      | 35,624         | RENAMES.md report mapping; normalized source text and value; line only breaks ties |                          |
| new tidy records   | 32,465 |                                       |                                            | 28,770         | unmatched and ambiguous provenance stays unmapped                                  | 3,695                    |

#### Match and unmapped reasons

| old record disposition                    | records | rule                                                                                  |
| ----------------------------------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| old rows transferred                      | 1,988   | RENAMES.md plus normalized source/value; line breaks ties                             |
| old rows still unmapped                   | 35,624  | includes excluded inputs, changed/unselected text, and ambiguous old matches          |
| new rows ambiguous                        | 731     | current claims with conflicting metadata or tied candidates; these are new-row counts |
| historical-log subset of transferred rows | 29      | M1 aggregate runs are not regeneration gaps                                           |
| previous exact-name/line/value baseline   | 653     | old rows matched before the correction; diagnostic baseline                           |
| old report basenames in RENAMES.md        | 29,669  | diagnostic count; this may overlap transferred and unmapped rows                      |

The regenerated ledger has **3,695** rows with transferred prior status/provenance and **28,770** rows marked unmapped. Mapping uses the report name after `RENAMES.md`, normalized source-text prefix, and value; the old line is only a tie-breaker. Ambiguous matches remain unmapped.

### M1 unrecoverable-claim recheck

The **29** M1 aggregate test-run records are classified as `historical-log`, not regeneration gaps. Current source evidence includes [golden PRNG vectors](../../crates/sim-core/tests/golden_prng_tests.rs), [determinism oracles](../../crates/sim-model/tests/determinism_oracle_tests.rs), [M0 graduation gate](../../crates/sim-model/tests/m0_determinism_gate_tests.rs), [snapshot tests](../../crates/sim-model/tests/phase11_snapshot_tests.rs), and the [M1 manifest](../../contracts/m1_contract.toml); these cover semantics and canonical values, not the historical aggregate run output.

## Findings

- The tidy ledger preserves one row per selected claim and leaves ambiguous or unmatched provenance unmapped; see the ledger comparison tables above.
- The M1 aggregate run records are historical logs and are excluded from regeneration gap totals.
- The largest gaps are grouped directly from the current status values in the tidy ledger; see Top evidence gaps.

## Limits

- A carried reproducible-now status means inputs/source are present; it does not claim that any harness was run in this inventory task.
- Values excluded as input/configuration or outside the selected claim contexts are not assigned new provenance.
- This report compares source evidence only and does not remeasure timings or run simulations.
